name: private_transfer
description: Tornado-style shielded spend: prove a Poseidon commitment is in a depth-16 Merkle tree of UTXOs, emit a single-use nullifier, bound to a public recipient address

secret.description: Spending key half: leaf = Poseidon(secret, nullifierSeed)

pathElements.description: Sibling hashes from leaf to root, bottom-up

pathIndices.description: Per-level direction bits (0 = current is left child, 1 = right), bottom-up

root.description: Public Merkle root of all live UTXO commitments

recipient.description: Recipient address packed into a field element. Bound into the proof to prevent withdraw-front-running
